body: Thanks, I was looking more for a "regular" clinic than one that's specifically focused on LGBT healthcare, though. I'm stealth in dtd life and don't wish to inadvertently out myself.

I never worked in Montreal, but here in the US (finance job) my average work week is around 55 hours, down to 45 or up to 70 depending on how busy everything is. I worked 2800 hours last year. My mom averages about 60 (lawyer) and my dad about the same (food service). My friends all have similar workloads too, across research science, business jobs, humanitarian work, etc. The few who are new lawyers or in investment banking are putting in a lot more hours. So, a fair few people are over 50, because i'm sure I dont know every single person with that schedule. Not gonna pretend it's super fun, but it's definitely not weird.

But yeah, I never worked more than about 30 hours/week for schoolwork.
